license: MIT: original authored sources; no external tasks or model-failure selection
acceptance: raw solution equals pinned-sandbox sanitized source modulo exterior whitespace
all 40 positive solutions pass and all 40 buggy solutions fail; per-family result reused across identical variant code
schema-valid allowlisted calls; quotes/newlines roundtrip in strings
complete final code and reasoning transition in source and rendered template
no truncated sequence, no silent teacher repair
exact pinned tokenizer/template and input hashes

teacher.mode: BF16 teacher forcing on original authored trajectories; no generation attempts
teacher.train_targets: not captured in this untrained baseline task

sequence_policy.cache: fresh per trajectory per forward, preserved across chunks
sequence_policy.memory_claim: inference only; no assertion that gradient calibration fits

regions.mapping: offset overlap in exact upstream template; target token labels (positions 1 onward)
regions.transition: closing think marker plus four adjacent tokens on each side, overriding other regions
regions.tool_call: tool call wrapper and serialized JSON, excluding transition overlap
regions.context: all remaining tokens; included in aggregate

objective.definition: teacher-to-student top-1024 renormalized KL at temperature 2; same objective as existing diagnostic, uniform per-token weighting, no T squared factor
objective.legacy: installed mlx_lm.tuner.losses.kl_div_loss in original logits dtype, sequence token sum in original dtype, host token-weighted aggregate
objective.fp32: evaluation-only logits cast before temperature scaling, FP32 KL and FP32 sequence reductions
objective.identical_logits: repeat zero gathered logits captured; both scorers see identical arrays before any repeated forwards
objective.comparison_order: same captured logits first, then four additional fresh-cache forwards
objective.historical: existing diagnostic results and gate not revised; absolute values from new contexts/chunking are not historical improvements

decision.relevant_gap: on at least one assistant region pristine C FP32 KL mean >=0.01 and mean exceeds its five-repeat range; report whether C also reproducibly trails MXFP4
decision.C_vs_MXFP4: C min > MXFP4 max and mean difference exceeds both observed repeat ranges in an assistant region
decision.qualification: five repeats are empirical ranges, not confidence intervals; no optimizer/model selection authorized

reserved_policy: no responses, tokenization, sandbox execution or logits for reserved tasks; never model selection
